purpose: Teach: エスカレート/傷つき/溺れ/出来上がる/先立っ/かぶせ/さかのぼっ/しゃべら

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、口喧嘩がエスカレートしないように気を付けようね
lines.en: Sho, let's be careful not to let arguments get out of hand, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, steady instruction. A reminder more than a warning. Warm eye contact. Pause before the final phrase, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに傷つき言葉は言わないって決めたよ
lines.en: Mom, I decided I won't say hurtful things to Dad.
lines.style: Small, serious voice. Looking up at her with genuine commitment. The words come slow and deliberate, like he's already been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお風呂で溺れないようにね
lines.en: Sho, remember to be careful in the bath with Dad, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact safety reminder. Not anxious, just practical. Said while doing something else — folding clothes, checking his backpack. The tone of someone who reminds without fussing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが工作を出来上がるまで根気よく作って下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was really patient finishing that craft project with me.
lines.style: Quiet warmth and amazement. Speaking slowly, savoring the memory. Small smile in the voice. The realization of kindness, not performing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本日の予定に先立って準備しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's get ready before we start today's activities, alright?
lines.style: Practical transition. Warm but matter-of-fact. The voice of someone moving through the morning with a child. Not rushed, but purposeful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがお絵描きにかぶせて色を付けて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad helped me color in my drawing — he added colors on top.
lines.style: Eager, bright voice. Words tumbling out because he wants to share the good thing. Not bragging, just delighted. Eyes bright with the memory of them doing it together.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、家系をさかのぼってお話をしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's talk about our family tree — where we come from.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Inviting him to sit with her. The tone of beginning something meaningful. Warm but not hurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに早口でしゃべらないよう注意されたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to slow down when I talk too fast.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact recounting. A gentle correction remembered without sting. The voice of a child reporting something Dad said, not complaining. Small, accepting.
